test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 24 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

The curry was very ________ (distasteful). I ate it all.
solution:
The correct answer is "**delicious**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• '**Distasteful**' means unpleasant or offensive. (अप्रिय)

 
 
• **Example**- The medicine had a distasteful aftertaste.
 
 
 
• '**Delicious**' means highly pleasing to the senses, especially to taste or smell, thus indicating the opposite of distasteful. (स्वादिष्ट)
 
 
• **Example**- The apples from the orchard are absolutely delicious.
 
 
 
• Hence, the option that is opposite in meaning to the given word is 'delicious'.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options.
 
• '**Refined**' means showing a high degree of elegance or politeness. (संस्कृत)
 
• '**Enchanting**' means delightfully charming or attractive. (मनोहारी)
 
• '**Intoxicating**' means causing or capable of causing intoxication. (नशीला) 

1b0:Tca8,

সঠিক উত্তৰ হ'ল "**সুস্বাদু**"।
